basic_details.job_title: IIT Jammu Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu) is inviting online applications for 1 Postdoctoral Fellow (PDF) vacancy on a temporary basis. The position offers a fellowship of Rs. 1,08,393/month and is valid for 1 year. Eligible candidates must have completed a Ph.D. in any research area relevant to Electrical Engineering. Applicants can apply through the specified online portal by filling out the form, uploading scanned copies of certificates and supporting documents, and selecting the appropriate tab on or before 18 October 2026. The selection process involves shortlisting based on merit

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Postdoctoral Fellow (PDF) at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu)
Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Phase II ("ESDM and IT/ITES")
Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
Rs. 1,08,393 per month (Fellowship) + Contingency Grant of Rs. 1,00,000/year + Travel support up to Rs. 2,10,000/year
Upper age limit is 40 years on the last date of application submission

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the following eligibility conditions specified in the notification: Nationality: Must be an Indian citizen. Educational Qualification: Must have obtained a PhD degree from a recognized University in any research area relevant to Electrical Engineering within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of application. Candidates must have secured a first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels with a good academic record throughout. Publications in reputed journals and conferences will be given weightage. Employment Status: Applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers with temporary positions in academia or research institutions may apply, but must relinquish their current roles if selected. Institution Restriction: Applicants must not have completed their PhD at the same institution (host institution) where the PDF fellowship is to be awarded. Academic Record: Must have a proven academic record including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Postdoctoral Fellow receives a fellowship of Rs. 1,08,393 per month . In addition, a contingency grant of Rs. 1,00,000 per year is provided. Travel support of up to Rs. 2,10,000 per year is limited to visa fees, one-time travel support for overseas faculty/applicants returning to India to take up the assignment, and participation in activities, events, or workshops of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme upon invitation from the PhD Cell, DIC. The position is full-time, non-transferable, and valid for 1 year.

content_sections.heading: Nature of Job
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for handling a project, carrying out research work, evaluating and mentoring PhD candidates, participating in collaborative research under the scheme, and participating in workshops and events.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Postdoctoral Fellow (PDF)
content_sections.text: Visit the online application portal at https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home . Navigate through the [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF/PDF] tab on the portal. Fill out the application form with the requested details. Upload scanned copies of educational qualification certificates, experience documents, and other supporting documents. Submit a one-page statement of purpose at the time of application submission. Complete and submit the application latest by 18 October 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and the needs of the project. Merely possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure a call for an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified of the interview date and time by email. The interview will be conducted in online mode. Selected candidates who are already employed must produce a relieving certificate from their employers.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly fellowship salary for the IIT Jammu Postdoctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fellowship of Rs. 1,08,393 per month, along with an annual contingency grant of Rs. 1,00,000 and travel support up to Rs. 2,10,000 per year.

faq.answer: Applicants must have completed a PhD within the past 5 years in any research area relevant to Electrical Engineering, with first-class grades in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates who completed their PhD at IIT Jammu apply for this position?
faq.answer: No, PDF applicants should not have completed their PhD at the same institution (host institution) where the PDF fellowship is to be awarded.

faq.answer: The interview will be conducted in online mode, and the date and time will be communicated via email to the shortlisted candidates.
